appnation-appnation:lever:51eba873-8401-.title: Marketing Manager
appnation-appnation:lever:51eba873-8401-.description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ downloads globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to lead the growth strategy of our AI-powered mobile products used by millions worldwide. You’ll own the performance marketing strategy end-to-end, combining data, creative insights, and product thinking to drive scalable growth. Working closely with Product, Creative, and Data teams, you’ll run experiments, optimize campaigns, and identify new opportunities to maximize business impact.
responsibilities: Lead and optimize multi-channel user acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other growth platforms.
Develop creative strategies by partnering with Creative teams, defining hypotheses, and turning performance insights into actionable improvements.
Analyze campaign performance using MMPs (AppsFlyer/Adjust), dashboards, and key metrics such as ROAS, LTV, and retention.
Own the full acquisition funnel, from user acquisition to subscription growth and monetization optimization.
Collaborate closely with Product teams to translate marketing insights into better user experiences and business outcomes.
Build strong platform partnerships and explore new channels, strategies, and experiments to unlock scalable growth opportunities.

aufinitygroupgmbh-aufinity-group-gmbh:as.title: Accountant (m/w/d)
aufinitygroupgmbh-aufinity-group-gmbh:as.description: ÜBER UNS Wir sind die aufinity Group GmbH - eines der am schnellsten wachsenden FinTech-Scale-ups in Deutschland. Gemeinsam bauen wir Europas neuen Standard für digitales Zahlungsmanagement im Automotive Bereich aus dem Herzen Kölns. Seit 2018 optimieren wir mit unserer Plattform bezahl.de http://bezahl.de die Zahlungsprozesse in der Automobilindustrie. bezahl.de http://bezahl.de automatisiert, digitalisiert und vereinfacht den gesamten Forderungsprozess von Rechnungsstellung, über Mahnwesen, bis zur Datenübergabe ans Finanzbuchhaltungssystem. Gleichzeitig bieten wir unserer Kundschaft einen hochmodernen Bezahlvorgang mit verschiedenen Multichannel-Zahlungsmethoden, die auf hohe Summen spezialisiert sind. So können unsere Kund:innen sich auf ihr Kerngeschäft fokussieren, während wir uns um den Rest kümmern. DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS - Finanzbuchhaltungs-Ownership: Eigenständige Durchführung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung inklusive Buchung, Kontenabstimmung und Vorbereitung von Abschlüssen - Abschluss-Support: Unterstützung bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen zur Sicherstellung termingerechter Finanzreportings - Finance-Process-Optimization: Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Finance-Prozesse und Strukturen - Operational-Finance-Support: Unterstützung im operativen Tagesgeschäft sowie Übernahme angrenzender Aufgaben innerhalb des Finance-Teams - Stakeholder-Management: Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit externen Steuerberater:innen sowie internationalen Ansprechpartner:innen - International-Finance-Support: Mitwirkung bei der Betreuung europäischer Tochtergesellschaften und internationalen Finance-Themenstellungen DAS BRINGST DU MIT - Accounting-Expertise: Solide Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung und Finanzbuchhaltung mit sicherem Verständnis relevanter Prozesse und Abläufe - ERP-&-Finance-Toolset: Gute Kenntnisse in gängigen Buchhaltungsprogrammen wie DATEV, Lexware, SAP oder vergleichbaren Systemen - Structured-Working-Style: Selbständige, strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch - Ownership-Mindset: Ausgeprägte Eigenverantwortung sowie Hands-on-Mentalität bei operativen und prozessbezogenen Aufgaben - Dynamic-Environment-Fit: Freude daran, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzudenken, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen aktiv voranzutreiben - Team-Collaboration: Hohe Teamorientierung und Flexibilität mit der Bereitschaft, sich in kleinen Teams gegenseitig zu unterstützen - International-Exposure: Erfahrung im internationalen Umfeld bzw. im Umgang mit europäischen Gesellschaften von Vorteil - Language-Skills: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie solide Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift DAS BIETEN WIR DIR - Excellence & Ownership: Übernimm die volle Verantwortung für deine Themen mit Fokus auf Qualität, Wirkung und nachhaltigen Impact - Purpose & Gestaltungsspielraum: Bring deine Ideen ein, forme deinen Verantwortungsbereich und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft sowie den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Company - Offenheit und Augenhöhe: Wir leben offene Kommunikation, den direkten Austausch und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe auf allen Ebenen - Wachstum ohne Stillstand: Ob durch Weiterbildungen, übergreifende Lernformate oder individuelles Mentoring, du bleibst fachlich und persönlich immer in Bewegung - Flexibel arbeiten, gemeinsam feiern: Wir bieten dir Benefits https://www.bezahl.de/unternehmen/karriere-im-besten-team#benefits, die den Unterschied machen. Workation Optionen, Team- und Company-Events oder Zuschuss zu Lunch, Internet & Deutschlandticket lassen dich aufs wesentliche fokussieren - Chancengleichheit: Kein Buzzword, sondern Haltung – wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Herkunft, Identität, sexueller Orientierlinkung oder Schwerbehinderung. Bei gleicher Eignung werden Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung besonders berücksichtigt

blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.title: Senior Editor, People Managing People
blackwhitezebra-black-white-zebra:lever:.description: About People Managing People: People Managing People helps executives and people leaders build AI-enabled, human-centered organizations that thrive. We provide peer-driven insights, practical frameworks, operational playbooks, and community-powered experiences focused on HR strategy, AI in the workplace, talent and recruitment, employee retention and culture, workforce management, and modern people leadership. Our audience includes CHROs, chief people officers, HR and people leaders, talent and recruiting leaders, operations executives, and senior people practitioners looking for practical insight, trustworthy guidance, and meaningful professional connection. About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Editor to help build People Managing People into a trusted, community-powered media brand for people leaders and HR professionals. This role is responsible for growing loyal, engaged people leadership and HR audiences through authoritative, practitioner-led editorial experiences across articles, newsletters, social, video, podcasts, livestreams, events, and strategic partnerships. This is not a traditional editing role focused only on publishing content. It is an audience growth and editorial leadership role centered on creating serious-fun, decision-support content that helps people leaders make better decisions, build healthier cultures, adopt AI-enabled ways of working, strengthen their teams, and navigate the changing realities of modern people leadership. You will help shape the voice, authority, growth, and audience experience of the brand. Your work should increase subscriber growth, newsletter engagement, return audience behavior, topical authority, and trust with people leaders and HR professionals. Who You Are: You understand how to create editorial brands that professionals actively trust, return to, and recommend. You are deeply curious about how people leaders and HR professionals operate, lead teams, adopt AI-enabled workflows, build culture, develop talent, and navigate organizational complexity. You know how to turn practitioner insight into useful editorial experiences that feel credible, clear, visual, engaging, and worth sharing. You are not just a writer or editor. You are a builder of audience systems, community loops, and repeat engagement. You think beyond articles and understand that modern editorial engagement happens across newsletters, video, podcasts, social, community discussions, livestreams, events, partnerships, search, and AI discovery experiences. You are comfortable experimenting with formats, workflows, packaging, distribution strategies, and audience experiences to improve performance over time. You care about usefulness, clarity, audience trust, and measurable impact. What You’ll Be Doing: 1. Build engaged, community-powered editorial experiences You will create serious-fun, expert-driven editorial and audience experiences that grow subscribers, increase newsletter engagement, and build loyal engineering, AI, and technology leadership audiences. Create, assign, edit, write, and publish editorial content across articles, newsletters, social, short-form video, narrative video, podcasts, livestreams, events, and community formats Develop content informed by real practitioner insight, including interviews, contributor conversations, engineering communities, surveys, Q&As, and social listening Create audience experiences focused on engineering leadership, AI adoption, scalability, platform reliability, developer productivity, infrastructure, security, and modern technology execution Help program and support webinars, livestreams, roundtables, podcasts, and editorial event experiences Repurpose editorial IP into newsletter blocks, social content, video clips, lead magnets, reports, and community assets Ensure editorial output reflects the publication’s tone, usefulness, authority, and audience relevance Continuously identify opportunities to increase audience participation, contribution, sharing,

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:b6d.title: Custom Boot Fitter - Part Time (Backcountry Outlet)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:b6d.description: Backcountry Outlet is a new retail division built on a simple idea: expert gear guidance paired with accessible pricing. It’s a place where seasoned skiers, first-time mountain bikers, and families alike can confidently gear up for what’s next. Our stores are powered by Gearheads who live the lifestyle—skiing, riding, hiking, and climbing—and bring that credibility to every customer interaction. This isn’t transactional retail; it’s about connecting people to the right gear, providing expert ski, snowboard, and bike services, and creating a reason to come back. The ideal candidate should have a passion for outdoor activities and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. As a Seasonal Custom Boot Fitter at Backcountry Outlet, you’ll be responsible for delivering top-tier, personalized ski and snowboard boot fitting services. You’ll work hands-on with customers to assess fit issues, perform custom modifications, and ensure every skier or rider leaves with boots that enhance comfort, control, and performance. This role requires both technical skill and a passion for helping people get the most out of their time on snow.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ad534358-c35a-.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ad534358-c35a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Recruiting Coordinator based in the United States. This is a fully remote opportunity for a detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to support a fast-paced, high-volume Talent Acquisition function. You will help coordinate the recruiting lifecycle, from job postings and candidate communication through interviews and pre-employment requirements. The role offers broad exposure to recruiting operations while partnering closely with recruiters, hiring managers, HR teams, and candidates. You will play an important role in keeping hiring workflows organized, timely, and candidate-friendly. Success in this position requires strong organization, communication, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities accurately. The environment is collaborative and performance-focused, with opportunities to contribute to process improvements and recruiting efficiency. Post and maintain job openings across internal and external recruiting platforms, including LinkedIn, Indeed, and applicant tracking systems. Support recruiters with candidate sourcing, resume screening, initial outreach, and other recruiting activities as needed. Coordinate interviews and hiring activities among candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and HR stakeholders. Maintain accurate candidate records, workflow statuses, scheduling information, and documentation within the ATS. Communicate consistently and professionally with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely updates and helping deliver a positive candidate experience. Assist with pre-employment activities such as background checks, licensing reviews, and onboarding-related requirements. Build effective working relationships with recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers across multiple teams to ensure smooth internal communication. Prepare recruiting activity reports and metrics to monitor candidate movement and support hiring decisions. Stay informed about recruiting tools, trends, and practices and contribute ideas that improve workflow efficiency. Provide additional administrative and recruiting support as required to help the Talent Acquisition team meet its goals. Requirements Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is preferred. 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting support, HR administration, or a similar fast-paced professional environment. Familiarity with recruiting platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed, and applicant tracking systems; experience with Jobvite is a plus. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a professional, courteous approach to candidates and internal stakeholders. Strong customer-service mindset with a genuine interest in creating positive candidate and employee experiences. High attention to detail when handling scheduling, candidate data, documentation, and recruiting workflows. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive candidate and employee information appropriately. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with distributed teams. Reliable high-speed internet suitable for remote work is required, with Ethernet connectivity and minimum speeds appropriate to the level of usage. Benefits Hourly compensation generally ranging from $23–$33 per hour , depending on applicable factors and location. Fully remote work within the United States. 401(k) plan. Medical, dental, and vision insurance. Life and disability insurance. Paid time off and 12 paid holidays per year . Paid training and professional development opportunities. Employee discounts. Referral program and pot

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec794583-bc40-.title: Senior Consultant
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec794583-bc40-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Consultant based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to support mission-focused healthcare programs serving federal government clients. You will work alongside multidisciplinary teams to assess current-state challenges, design future-state solutions, and translate complex findings into actionable recommendations. The position combines consulting, healthcare transformation, research, process improvement, and change management. You will engage with stakeholders ranging from clinical professionals and program teams to senior executives. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, polished communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment. You will also contribute to high-visibility deliverables that can influence the delivery and effectiveness of healthcare programs. Support federal healthcare engagements by contributing to program planning, implementation, transformation initiatives, and mission-focused projects. Work with clinical and non-clinical stakeholders to understand needs, design interventions, and develop practical solutions to complex healthcare challenges. Conduct current-state assessments and develop journey maps that clearly communicate future-state concepts and proposed improvements. Perform primary and secondary industry research to identify leading practices, emerging trends, and opportunities to strengthen clinical and operational programs. Analyze existing processes and practices, identify gaps and opportunities, and develop recommendations for process and program improvements. Develop high-visibility consulting deliverables, including business cases, change management and communications plans, operational manuals, program checklists, evaluation plans, presentations, and briefing materials. Support stakeholder meetings, facilitate discussions, organize complex information, and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to diverse audiences. Maintain strong, solution-oriented client relationships while contributing to long-term engagement success and business development opportunities. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams while remaining adaptable to changing priorities, organizational needs, and client requirements. Requirements Bachelor’s degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree with at least 6 years of relevant experience. Professional experience within a consulting organization, healthcare-related government entity, large integrated healthcare delivery system, or a combination of these environments. Demonstrated experience applying consulting methodologies such as change management, process improvement, human-centered design, environmental or market analysis, and qualitative or quantitative research. Strong ability to simplify complex information and translate it into clear, accessible, and actionable materials for technical and non-technical audiences. Excellent writing, presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, with experience developing business cases, operational documentation, presentation decks, and communications materials. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, establish priorities, determine appropriate next steps, and consistently meet deadlines. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative, accountable, and high-performing teams. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clinical staff, program leaders, and senior executives. Master’s degree in Public Health or a related discipline is preferred. Experience supporting healthcare transformation initiative

The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service!
